headline: ‘Just wrong’: British right distances itself from Trump after Putin ‘friend’ post

members.title: ‘Just wrong’: British right distances itself from Trump after Putin ‘friend’ post
members.lead: Reform deputy leader calls Russian leader ‘a murderous dictator’ after US president appears to endorse him UK politics live – latest updates Reform UK and the Conservatives have distanced themselves from Donald Trump after the US president posted a photo of himself shaking hands with Vladimir Putin with the caption: “My friend.” The US president had already used the term to describe the Russian president while at last week’s Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in Shenzhen, southern China, where he also met the Chinese president, Xi Jinping. Continue reading...

members.title: US intelligence chief says he trusts Trump’s description of Putin as ‘my friend’
members.lead: Jay Clayton was pressed on Trump’s characterization of Putin during media appearances on Sunday Jay Clayton, the US director of national intelligence, said he trusts Donald Trump “completely” after the US president called Vladimir Putin “a friend” during their recent meeting in China. Clayton made the remarks on Sunday, where he was pressed during media appearances on Trump’s warm characterization of the Russian president – who is viewed as a chief US adversary – following his trilateral summit with Putin and China’s Xi Jinping. After a backlash at home and aboard, Trump doubled down on Saturday and posted a photo of himself and Putin shaking hands with the caption “My Friend.” Continue reading...
